title: Egyptian Lamb Kebabs with Warm Spices
description: A flavorful and aromatic lamb kebab recipe inspired by Egyptian cuisine, served with a blend of warm spices.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder or leg, cut into 1-inch cubes
Warm spice blend (cinnamon, cardamom, cumin, coriander)

instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, warm spice blend, salt, and black pepper.
2. Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
3. Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
4. Brush the skewers with the remaining spice mixture.
5. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
6. Grill the kebabs for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
7. Transfer the kebabs to a plate and garnish with chopped parsley and cilantro.
8. Serve with lemon wedges and pita bread or flatbread.
